title_zh: AI 朝圣与荣誉节点交叉索引
author: 许丙南
boundary_note: These are proposed public markers and governance interfaces, not approved structures, heritage alterations, advertising sites or institutional endorsements.

nodes.location: 京张遗址公园公共界面
nodes.function: Translate cleared railway engineering questions into an inspectable public learning and contribution record.
nodes.policy_enterprise_value: Makes the origin of a public problem, the responsible test team and the evidence needed for a solution visible without turning history into a marketing claim.
nodes.acceptance_test: Every displayed item has a source/rights record, a plain-language explanation and a removal route.

nodes.location: AI 原点社区开源发布厅
nodes.function: Display attributed, withdrawable contributions, model cards, project questions and public feedback.
nodes.policy_enterprise_value: Gives startups, university teams and public buyers a durable record of contribution, attribution, revision and unresolved risk.
nodes.acceptance_test: A contributor can correct or withdraw an item; the ledger preserves the change reason without retaining individual behaviour trails.

nodes.location: 大钟寺企业服务与公共状态节点
nodes.function: Show the current AI service purpose, data boundary, human owner, complaint path, non-AI route and withdrawal state.
nodes.policy_enterprise_value: Turns an enterprise or public-service pilot into a reviewable service contract rather than an invisible recommendation engine.
nodes.acceptance_test: A visitor can find the owner, manual equivalent, current test window and correction route without an account or app.

nodes.location: 众智园安全治理沙盒公共边界
nodes.function: Publicly explain which enterprise test is running, what safety evidence is required and why a test was stopped or returned to ordinary use.
nodes.policy_enterprise_value: Creates a bounded trust interface for suppliers and public buyers while keeping procurement, safety, privacy and rights decisions human-led.
nodes.acceptance_test: A failed test produces a plain-language stop note, named reviewer and next evidence requirement; no logo or performance claim is displayed without clearance.
